title: Compute surface formation energies
action: Perform periodic DFT calculations for the close‑packed surfaces of Ru(0001), Ni(111), and Pt(111) with Sn atoms substituting surface metal atoms. Use the PBE exchange‑correlation functional with the Tkatchenko–Scheffler van der Waals correction. Build a 5‑layer 4×4 slab, fix the bottom two layers, add 30 Å vacuum, use an energy cutoff ≥400 eV and a 5×5×1 k‑mesh with dipole corrections. For each metal, consider Sn coverages of 0.25, 0.50, and 0.75 monolayer (ML), where coverage is the fraction of surface atoms replaced. For every coverage, compute the average formation energy per Sn atom, ΔE_f, defined as the energy of the surface with Sn relative to the clean surface and bulk Sn. Write the results to formation_energies.csv with columns metal, coverage_ML, delta_E_f_eV_per_Sn.
description: DFT‑computed average bimetallic surface formation energy per Sn atom for Ru, Ni, and Pt at coverages 0.25, 0.5, 0.75 ML.
output_schema: CSV with columns: metal (string: Ru, Ni, Pt), coverage_ML (float: 0.25, 0.5, 0.75), delta_E_f_eV_per_Sn (float, energy in eV per Sn atom). One row per (metal, coverage) combination.

title: Compute subsurface‑to‑surface segregation energies
action: Using the same DFT slab settings (PBE+TS‑vdW, 5‑layer 4×4 slab, bottom two layers fixed, 30 Å vacuum, cutoff ≥400 eV, 5×5×1 k‑mesh, dipole corrections), compute the average subsurface‑to‑surface segregation energy per Sn atom, ΔE_seg, for M = Ru, Ni, Pt at Sn coverages of 0.25, 0.5, 0.75 ML. ΔE_seg is defined as the energy difference between a configuration with Sn atoms in the top surface layer and the corresponding configuration with Sn atoms in the subsurface layer. Write the results to segregation_energies.csv with columns metal, coverage_ML, delta_E_seg_eV_per_Sn.
description: DFT‑computed average subsurface‑to‑surface segregation energy per Sn atom for Ru, Ni, and Pt at coverages 0.25, 0.5, 0.75 ML.
output_schema: CSV with columns: metal (string: Ru, Ni, Pt), coverage_ML (float: 0.25, 0.5, 0.75), delta_E_seg_eV_per_Sn (float, energy in eV per Sn atom). One row per (metal, coverage) combination.
